span.p:
GLOBAL TRAFFIC MANAGER
Route53 Geo-DNS
+ CloudFront
CDN + Global Accelerator
Health checks:
5s interval,
3 consecutive
failures → failover

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.div:
CROSS-REGION INFRASTRUCTURE
Global Accelerator │ Direct Connect │ Transit Gateway
MONITORING: CloudWatch + Prometheus + Grafana (global)
ORCHESTRATION: Terraform (multi-region modules)
CI/CD: Deploy to one region at a time, verify, proceed
SECRETS: AWS Secrets Manager replicated across regions
